points.description: States that the purpose of the desiccator is to cool the samples, i.e. bring down their temperature (from the oven/furnace temperature) to room temperature.

States that cooling is done without condensation and without moisture addition/absorption from the surroundings (the desiccator keeps the sample dry). Both no condensation and no moisture gain from surroundings must be stated.
points.partial_credit: Only one of 'no condensation' or 'no moisture addition from surroundings' stated precisely earns 0; a vague 'keeps it dry' earns nothing.

rubric.notes: Full marks need both: cooling/bringing down the temperature, and doing so with no condensation and no moisture added from the surroundings. Each point is all or nothing; vague statements such as 'to keep it safe' or 'to store samples' earn nothing. Any wrong statement (e.g. desiccator is used to heat or to add moisture) loses that point.
